summary: Iter 61 backend testing — CFO Business Case Generator + Dark Funnel Phase 1 + Sovereign Audit Trail Phase 1. Wrote 16-case pytest suite covering all required scenarios (3 industry CFO cases + general fallback, audit trail linkage, tracked redirect with score+20, Resend webhook ingestion, engagement-spike detection + idempotency, re-engagement scanner gating + idempotency, lead-engagement detail, audit/list + lead-trail, auth negative tests, Iter 60 regression via tracked redirect, Iter 59 orchestrator 5-row audit instrumentation regression). 16/16 PASSED in 168s. No backend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: cfo_business_case.py — auth_email/token are accepted in the request body but verified silently (try/except pass). Acceptable for an auth-optional endpoint, just be aware bad tokens silently no-op.

dark_funnel.py /webhook/resend — when RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset there is NO signature verification at all. In production this MUST be set or any caller can spam open/click events and inflate signal_score. Recommend logging a clear warning at startup if missing in non-dev envs.

dark_funnel.py reengagement_scan_once query uses both '$lt: cutoff' and '$exists: true' inside the same dict — pymongo accepts it but the '$exists' is redundant when '$lt' is set; consider simplifying.

dark_funnel.py /lead-engagement endpoint accepts a free-form dict and re-validates with an inner Pydantic model — works but defining a top-level model would give automatic OpenAPI schema and 422 errors.
audit_trail.py record_decision is best-effort (good) but failures are only logged at WARNING — confirm log volume in prod and consider counter metrics.
audit_trail.py /detail endpoint instantiates TrailQuery with limit=1 just to trigger validation — feels hacky; a dedicated DetailRequest model would be cleaner.
cfo_business_case.py — 50s LLM timeout is generous; if Claude rate-limits, the user will see a generic 503 from the correction agent. Consider surfacing retry_count in the response.
